target_customer: Data and business teams needing reliable business metrics (Structured launch posts); later developers and teams publishing technical knowledge (Waldium)
problem: Teams lack a single source of truth for key business metrics. The company later moved to helping developers research, write and publish technical content that both people and AI systems can use.
product_category: Data tooling, later AI content and knowledge publishing

founders.name: Amrutha Gujjar
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page with no bio. The company's site signs off as Amrutha and Shivam.

founders.name: Shivam Singhal
founders.background_notes: Listed under data infrastructure on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: A semantic layer for business metrics needs warehouse integrations and query generation. The later content product relies on LLM pipelines.

defensibility.rationale: Metric layers and AI content tools were both crowded categories with no data or lock in advantage described.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not established for this company. No acquisition was found.

market_need_then: The YC launch posts frame a need for reliable shared business metrics. No demand evidence for the Waldium content product at founding was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses structuredlabs.com and waldium.com for the product.

identity.visual_style: Company GitHub lists a design system called Glyphwald, suggesting a shared wald naming family (inference, not confirmed)
identity.voice_and_tone: Positioning line: the publishing layer for the agentic internet

brand_strength.rationale: Other companies are named Structured or Structured AI and sources mix them up, and no brand press was found.

pivots.from: Structured, semantic layer for business metrics (YC launch posts)
pivots.to: Waldium, AI publishing of technical knowledge (YC description)

outcome_analysis: Structured Labs entered S23 with a business metrics product, reported a 500 thousand dollar seed in August 2023, and moved its positioning to Waldium, a platform for publishing technical knowledge for humans and AI. The YC directory flags it inactive but its site is live and no shutdown notice exists, so the outcome is unresolved and no failure factor is assigned.
notes: Status conflict: the YC page showed Inactive while a search summary of YC listed Active; the site is live, so exit is none. The seed rests on VCBacked and Village.ai (and a startupintros item dated 2023-08-01), all aggregator style; Village also claims General Catalyst and Z Fellows, unconfirmed. Founder labels come from the YC page; the company site does not call them founders explicitly. No dated competitor sources were found (search returned 2026 comparisons), so the list is empty. Several results mix this company with Waldium, Structured AI and Wald.ai.
